categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of specialized functional wet electronic chemicals used in printed circuit boards (PCBs), packaging substrates, and advanced semiconductor packaging. Its product portfolio includes chemical copper deposition chemicals, electroplating chemicals, copper surface treatment chemicals, advanced packaging chemicals, and other specialized chemicals. The company also focuses on expanding into semiconductor core materials and integrated circuit functional wet electronic chemicals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary chemical deposition, electrochemical deposition, and interface treatment technologies developed over nearly 30 years. Key technologies include horizontal chemical copper deposition, electroplating with insoluble anodes and pulse plating, and advanced surface treatment processes such as micro-etching and roughening. Production involves precise formulation of liquid chemical products, mainly water-based and solvent-based, mixed under controlled conditions. The company also emphasizes environmentally friendly and cost-effective processes, including recycling and waste reduction.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturers of high-end PCBs, packaging substrates, semiconductor advanced packaging, and display panels. The company serves leading domestic PCB manufacturers and semiconductor packaging firms, including well-known enterprises like Dongshan Precision, Deep South Circuit, and others. The end markets include electronics, telecommunications, automotive electronics, AI computing, and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Guangdong, Shanghai, and Zhuhai. It is actively expanding overseas, notably establishing a production base in Thailand to serve Southeast Asian markets. The company also targets global markets through export sales and international cooperation, aiming to enhance its international competitiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the electronic chemical materials supply chain, producing specialized functional wet electronic chemicals essential for PCB and semiconductor manufacturing processes. It supplies critical raw materials and chemical additives that are integral to the fabrication and assembly stages of electronic components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on high-quality growth by enhancing R&D capabilities, expanding product lines, and promoting domestic substitution of imported materials. R&D priorities include developing advanced chemical copper deposition and electroplating additives for high-frequency, high-density PCBs, semiconductor packaging (TSV, RDL, bumping, TGV), and new materials for 5G and AI applications. The company invests heavily in innovation, patent development, and building a platform for semiconductor core materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of specialized functional wet electronic chemical products to PCB manufacturers, semiconductor packaging companies, and related industries. The company mainly uses a direct sales model with some distribution, and pricing is based on product volume, contract terms, and customized solutions. It also earns income from financial investments and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international giants such as Atotech (Amtech), DowDuPont, MacDermid, and JCU, which dominate the high-end functional wet electronic chemicals market. However, it holds a leading position domestically, leveraging faster customer response, localized technical support, and increasing market share in China's growing PCB and semiconductor sectors. The company is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' and a manufacturing 'single champion'.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 380.7 million, a 12.32% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 74.68 million, up 27.5%. Total assets reached RMB 1.24 billion, with steady growth in net assets. R&D investment accounted for 7.35% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth and innovation trajectory. The company has expanded its share capital and maintained positive cash flows from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product matrix, and ability to provide customized chemical solutions tailored to diverse customer production processes. It offers high-quality, stable, and reliable functional wet electronic chemicals that meet stringent technical and environmental standards, supporting high-frequency, high-density, and advanced semiconductor packaging applications. Its rapid technical support and localized service differentiate it from foreign competitors, enhancing customer loyalty and enabling domestic substitution of imported products.
